W Palantirze dążymy do rozwiązywania najważniejszych i najbardziej wymagających problemów na świecie. Wierzymy, że tworzenie oprogramowania umożliwiającego podejmowanie decyzji przez ludzi jest najlepszym sposobem na osiągnięcie tego celu. Współpracujemy z najważniejszymi instytucjami na świecie, aby przeobrazić sposób, w jaki wykorzystują dane i technologię. Nasze oprogramowanie było wykorzystywane m.in. do powstrzymania ataków terrorystycznych, odkrywania nowych leków, zdobywania przewagi na globalnych rynkach finansowych.

 Rola

Jako analityk ds. niezawodności systemów i operacji jesteś siłą napędową wdrożeń rozwiązań Palantir. Odpowiadasz za opracowywanie, wdrażanie i realizację procesów, które usprawniają przepływ pracy i ograniczają utrudnienia. Monitorujesz projekty i dbasz o ich stabilny przebieg, usuwasz przeszkody oraz przewidujesz potrzeby klientów, aby nasi inżynierowie mogli skupić się na rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych, do których są najlepiej przygotowani.

Na tym stanowisku potrzebne są umiejętności zarządzania projektami, optymalizacji procesów i skutecznej realizacji zadań. Lubisz rozwiązywać problemy i zawsze stawiasz na najlepszy pomysł, nawet jeśli nie jest Twój.

 Podstawowe obowiązki

 Zajmuj się różnorodnymi problemami i wyzwaniami. Jednego dnia możesz wspierać wdrożenie u dużego klienta o globalnym zasięgu, a już następnego lecieć na drugi koniec świata, aby pomóc przy nowym projekcie pilotażowym.

 Bądź jedną z pierwszych osób, które reagują, gdy pojawiają się problemy. Nawet jeśli problem wykracza poza obszar Twojej specjalizacji, podejmujesz inicjatywę, by go rozwiązać, i prosisz o pomoc dopiero wtedy, gdy wyczerpiemy wszystkie dostępne nam możliwości.

 Opracowuj i wdrażaj procesy, które ograniczają utrudnienia i pozwalają wszystkim członkom zespołu skupić się na tym, co robią najlepiej.

 Myśl kreatywnie, współpracuj i rób wszystko, aby wykonać zadanie.

  Co sobie cenimy

 Wyjątkowa umiejętność podejmowania trafnych decyzji i zachowania spokoju pod dużą presją.

 Kreatywne podejście do zarządzania projektami oparte na prostych i elastycznych metodykach, które umożliwiają szybkie wprowadzanie kolejnych zmian i bieżące informowanie klientów o postępach bez zbędnych formalności.

 Udokumentowane sukcesy w budowaniu owocnych relacji z klientami opartych na współpracy.

 Skrupulatna dbałość o szczegóły, w tym prowadzenie dokładnej dokumentacji i staranne śledzenie kluczowych wskaźników projektu.

 Zaangażowanie w pracę na miejscu u klientów i/lub we wspieranie projektów wewnętrznych oraz kadry kierowniczej wyższego szczebla, połączone z umiejętnością wprowadzania ładu i usprawniania kluczowych inicjatyw wewnętrznych.

  Wymagania

 Gotowość do podróży służbowych obejmujących 25–75% czasu pracy (w zależności od lokalizacji i zespołu).

 Co najmniej 3 lata doświadczenia w zarządzaniu projektami lub programami, najlepiej w dynamicznym środowisku o szybkim tempie pracy.

 Gotowość do pracy stacjonarnej w naszej lokalizacji (lokalizacjach) w Warszawie przez pięć dni w tygodniu.

 Biegła znajomość języka polskiego.

 Życie w Palantir

 Chcemy, aby każdy z pracowników firmy Palantir osiągał najlepsze wyniki, dlatego doceniamy mocne strony, umiejętności i zainteresowania poszczególnych osób od pierwszej rozmowy kwalifikacyjnej po długoterminowy rozwój, zamiast polegać na tradycyjnych drabinach kariery. Zwracanie uwagi na potrzeby naszej społeczności umożliwia nam optymalizację naszych możliwości rozwoju i pomaga zapewnić wiele dróg do sukcesu w Palantir. Promowanie zdrowia i dobrego samopoczucia we wszystkich obszarach życia pracowników firmy Palantir to tylko jeden ze sposobów inwestowania w naszą społeczność. Dowiedz się więcej na stronie  Życie w Palantir  i pamiętaj, że nasza oferta może się różnić w zależności od regionu.

 Wierzymy, że postępowanie zgodne z wartościami i kulturą firmy Palantir sprawia, iż pracownicy „lepiej współpracują ze sobą”, a praca osobista daje możliwość bardziej kreatywnych wyników. Dlatego zachęcamy pracowników do pracy w naszych biurach, aby wspierać powiązania i innowacje. Wiele zespołów oferuje opcje hybrydowe (dzień lub dwa dni w tygodniu pracy w domu), dzięki czemu nasi pracownicy mogą uzyskać odpowiedni kompromis dla swojej osobistej produktywności. W zależności od potrzeb biznesowych istnieje kilka ról, które pozwalają na „zdalną” pracę w wyjątkowych warunkach. You’ll be constantly exploring new horizons and building new skills in service of real world needs: between type theory, operational transforms, 2D and 3D mapping, UI design systems, high-scale graphics rendering, evidence-based performance optimization, and the never-ending need to decompose user asks into rich, sophisticated, and maintainable software, there is always a new challenge to be faced.

Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.

Designers at Palantir develop a deep understanding of the problems our customers face while solving some of the world’s most unique challenges. Our mission is to build generalizable and scalable solutions that elegantly handle the complexity of these problem spaces.

  User research . We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.

  Deliver and communicate designs in close collaboration . We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers and product managers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.

  Awareness of how software interfaces are built.    Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies.

 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

  The Role

 As a technical writer and editor, you’ll play a key role in helping our customers succeed by creating, maintaining, and improving documentation that supports users of Palantir’s products.

 At Palantir, we view documentation as a key part of product development. Working at the intersection of users and Palantir’s products, you will develop an understanding of user needs and help them get the most out of our software. You’ll be a thought partner with our product development teams, combining your communication skills with empathy for users and product knowledge. Your work will primarily be on written documentation, but may also include interactive tutorials, recorded demonstrations, or other communication channels.

 Teams and individuals at Palantir operate with a high degree of autonomy and independence. In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting priorities for your work, deciding where to allocate your time based on an assessment of stakeholder and organizational needs. You should be comfortable thinking about the “big picture” narrative and structure of our documentation, as well as diving into the details. On any given day, you might find yourself editing a guide drafted by a developer, writing a new tutorial for a critical workflow, or identifying an area that needs improvement and partnering with a team to make the fix. You will also gain exposure to the technical infrastructure for composing and distributing platform documentation.

 Core Responsibilities
  Understand and communicate the value proposition of Palantir’s products.

 Create user documentation in partnership with developers and business teams.

 Review and edit documentation to maintain a high level of quality.

 Identify, triage, and resolve needs in documentation.

 Maintain style guides and best practices for writing, improving, and publishing documentation.

 Manage and structure multi-stakeholder documentation projects.

 Uphold a culture in which developers are engaged with documenting their products, including hosting training sessions and workshops.

 What We Value
  Commitment to quality and accuracy in communication and writing, with the ability to translate complex technical subjects into clear, concise prose suited for the intended audience.

 Ability to prioritize, adapt, and operate in unstructured environments as part of a fast-moving team.

 Enthusiasm for learning about and communicating new technology and concepts.

 Experience working with engineering teams as part of the software development process.

 What We Require
  Outstanding writing and editing skills.

 3+ years of technical writing experience or similar experience in software development.

 Experience with programming, scripting, or statistical packages; previous work in software engineering or data science is a plus.

  Salary

 The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $88,000 - $122,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

 Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.

   Benefits

 •  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance

 •  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance

 •  Commuter benefits

 •  Relocation assistance

 •  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based

 •  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)

 •  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year

 •  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events

 •  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents

 •  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation

 •  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child

 •  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan

   Life at Palantir

 We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at  Life at Palantir  and note that our offerings may vary by region.

 In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

 If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process ,  please  reach out  and let us know how we can help.

title: Production Engineer - Database Operations
descriptionPlain:
A World-Changing Company

 Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

  The Role

 Database Operations is responsible for the deployment and maintenance of the database layer that Palantir’s products depend on. As an engineer on the Database Operations team, you will design how databases are deployed and operated across a wide variety of environments, build the automation and observability that keep them healthy, and respond to the critical production issues that affect some of the world's most impactful use cases.

 Core Responsibilities
  Build software that automates the routine work of deploying and running production databases

 Participate in regular on-call rotations

 Troubleshoot, diagnose, and remediate stability and reliability issues in production database systems

 Participate in post-incident reviews and take ownership of follow up actions

 Identify patterns across incidents, support tickets, and alerts, and translate those observations into proposals for systemic improvements to our fleet

 Manage and execute large scale migrations of the fleet of databases we run

 Partner with customer-facing teams during incidents and when setting up new database installations

 Work with database engineering teams and infrastructure teams to build resilient and highly available database systems

 Continuously invest in documentation, metrics, monitors and other troubleshooting tools

 Hold the bar on engineering and operational standards through code reviews, design reviews, and feedback on operating procedures

 Build deep expertise and experience in production systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, etc.) and share that knowledge amongst the team

 What We Value
  Strong sense of ownership in ambiguous environments. You step in to drive important outcomes when lines of responsibility are unclear.

 Ability to collaborate and empathize under pressure. You stay calm and work effectively during high-stakes incidents.

 Curiosity and motivation to learn. The systems and technologies you work on will change often, and you can quickly build the understanding to be effective through the changes.

 Ability to operate with autonomy in a rapidly changing environment where priorities shift.

 First-principles thinking. You want to thoroughly understand the systems you work on rather than applying band-aid fixes, and you ask questions to get there.

 Investment in the team around you. You share what you learn, give thoughtful feedback in reviews, and treat raising the team's overall capability as part of the job.

 What We Require
  Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics or similar field.

 Experience writing code a variety of programming languages such as Java, Python, and Go, as part of a past role or personal projects.

 Experience with cloud and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, GCP, Azure, and OpenShift.

 Experience with database technologies such as Cassandra, Elasticsearch and Kafka.

 A solid foundation in Linux and how distributed web services work.

 Familiarity with observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.

 Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to iterate quickly with teammates and incorporate feedback.

 Palantir is particularly interested in applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and we encourage Singapore citizens to apply.

This is not a research-only internship. You’ll own a project with hands-on mentorship from experienced engineers, contributing to the systems that make production AI useful and trustworthy. title: Neurodivergent Fellowship

 Palantir builds the world's leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving technologies, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, improve the efficacy of the American government, and more.

   The Program

 Neurodivergent individuals will play a disproportionate role in shaping the future of America and the West. They see past performative ideologies and perceive beauty in the world that still exists — which technology and art can expose.

 The current LLM tech landscape positions them to dominate. Pattern recognition. Non-linear thinking. Hyperfocus. The cognitive traits that make the neurodivergent different are precisely what make them exceptional in an AI-driven world.

 Palantir is launching the Neurodivergent Fellowship as a recruitment pathway for exceptional neurodivergent talent. This is not a diversity initiative. We believe neurodivergent individuals will have a competitive advantage as elite builders of the next technological era, and we're hiring accordingly for all roles.

 This program is designed for those who think differently, and that's the point. Whether you're self-taught, formally educated, or somewhere in between, we're looking for builders who can see patterns others miss and solutions others overlook.

 You'll join Palantir as a full-time employee to build software and deliver customer outcomes. title: Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing [Analytics, Models & AI]
descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

 What You'll Do

 Develop, maintain and continuously improve Spotify’s global transfer pricing models for quarter-end and year-end closes.

 Prepare and review quarterly and annual transfer pricing calculations, delivering them within internal and reporting deadlines.

 Turn externally prepared benchmarking studies and economic analyses into practical inputs for our transfer pricing models.

 Partner with FP&A and finance business partners on future transfer pricing outcomes and projections.

 Drive the adoption of AI tools and automation to make transfer pricing processes more efficient, accurate and scalable.

 Work with Spotify’s data and technology teams to transform how financial data for transfer pricing transactions is sourced and handled.

 Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, Accounting and Legal on transfer pricing matters, and support tax audits with documentation, analyses and outcome scenarios.

 Contribute to transfer pricing documentation, including local files and master files.

 Who You Are

 You have 5+ years of experience in transfer pricing, gained at a Big 4 firm, in industry, or both. Experience in the tech industry is a plus.

 You hold a degree in accounting, finance, economics, business administration or law.

 You have hands-on transfer pricing operations experience, including model-building, economic analysis, valuation analysis and benchmarking.

 You have strong analytical and quantitative skills and can build and maintain complex financial models in Google Sheets or Excel. Experience with SQL, Python or other data tools is a strong plus.

 You’ve worked with financial systems such as ERP, consolidation and management reporting tools. Knowledge of NetSuite is a plus.

 You use AI tools to improve efficiency and quality in your daily work, and you’re curious about new ways to apply them.

 You have supported the transfer pricing aspects of tax audits and prepared defence files.

 You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and you’ve worked well in cross-functional, cross-border teams.

 You’re intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable in a fast-paced, informal and often ambiguous environment.

 Where You'll Be
  This role is based in Stockholm.

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

  Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

  At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

 The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions.

 The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

 In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

 What You'll Do
  Lead a high-performing team focused on building a better future for artists, songwriters, and the music industry on Spotify.

 Set and execute against a policy agenda for the team based on the biggest needs for artists, songwriters, music partners, listeners, and Spotify.

 Own strategy and execution around Spotify’s music policy portfolio, including Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, Music Spam Filter, Preferred Provider Program, and more.

 Develop and implement new policies that equitably impact the music ecosystem on topics like royalty administration, artificial streaming, new music technologies, music platform rules, and more.

 Partner closely with technical and operational teams on content policy — including platform integrity issues, metadata strategy, and music supply chain dynamics.

 Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to implement technical solutions for our policy agenda.

 Craft clear, informative messaging about existing and new policies — and launch scaled educational initiatives to make sure artists, songwriters, distributors, and rights holders have accurate information about our platform.

 Collaborate with Music Partnerships and Licensing to understand the needs of all the stakeholders on our music platform, to advocate for and explain new policies, and to listen to and incorporate feedback.

 Partner with Data Science and Music Economics to deeply understand platform trends and the potential impact of various policy decisions.

 Who You Are

 You have 10+ years of relevant experience in the music industry, policy, legal, or technology platforms.

 You have proven experience in the music industry, working with artists and creators, and with technology platforms. You have a deep understanding of the music supply chain.

 You’re a dedicated people leader, caring deeply about the health and growth of the people on your team.

 You have a deep passion for technology, love getting into the weeds of technical solutions, and have experience working closely with engineering

 You have passion for creating a more rewarding, fairer experience for artists and songwriters around the world. You love music.

 You’re comfortable diving deep into spreadsheets, talking to technical teams, mapping out complex incentive systems, and sweating the details.

 You’re a strong communicator and a strong listener — understanding when to influence others and when to incorporate smart feedback.

 You’re experienced at bringing cross-functional teams together in a shared vision.

 Where You'll Be

 We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode best for them!

 Where in the world? For this role, it can be within the  Americas  region in which we have a work location

 Prefer an office to work from home instead? Not a problem! We have plenty of options for your working preferences. Find more information about our Work From Anywhere  options  here

 Working hours? We operate within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration, and you will be expected to work EST hours, no matter where you are located in the Americas region.

 The United States base range for this position is $181,000 – $259,000 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

  Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

  At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans.

 As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

 What You'll Do
  Manage a portfolio of artist and label relationships. Serve as the day-to-day contact for selected labels, distributors and artist teams. Stay close to their release plans and follow through on shared commitments

 Lead assigned artist campaigns from pitch to launch. Develop proposals, negotiate scope and commitments with artists and labels, and coordinate delivery with teams across Spotify in Korea and globally. Set clear timelines and responsibilities for release campaigns, video and content projects, and live fan experiences

title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
descriptionPlain:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

 We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

 Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.

 Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.

 Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.

 Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

 For more information, see this press release:  https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

 What You'll Do
  Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music.

 Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms.

 Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction.

 Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations.

 Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust.

 Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify.

 Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact.

 Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Perception 3D Segmentation
descriptionPlain:
The Perception team at Zoox is responsible for the robot’s understanding of the world, fusing data from Lidar, Radar, and Cameras to create a unified representation of the environment. In this role, you will contribute to the development of our next-generation 3D occupancy and segmentation networks. You will architect and optimize high-performance deep learning models that generate dense, temporally consistent voxel representations of the driving environment. This work is critical for enabling our vehicle to navigate complex urban scenarios, handle rare obstacles, and drive safely in tight spaces by providing precise geometry and motion estimates to downstream planners.

 In this role, you will...

 Design and implement state-of-the-art multi-modal sensor fusion architectures (Lidar, Camera, Radar) to predict 3D occupancy, semantic segmentation, and flow .

 Develop "vision-first" fusion strategies to enhance geometric understanding and reduce dependency on sparse sensor modalities .

 Engineer temporal processing modules to improve the stability and consistency of predictions over time.

 Optimize model architectures for real-time on-vehicle inference, balancing high-fidelity range extension with strict latency constraints .

 Collaborate with downstream consumers (Tracking, Prediction, Planner) to refine geometric outputs, such as contours and free-space estimations, for complex maneuvering.

 Qualifications

 MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or related field with 6+ years of industry experience.

 Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision and Deep Learning, specifically with voxel-based or BEV (Bird's Eye View) architectures.

 Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch) for model training and design as well as some experience in C++ for model integration.

 Experience with multi-sensor fusion (Lidar, Camera, Radar) and handling temporal data sequences.

 Experience with occupancy networks, implicit representations (NeRF/Gaussian Splats), or scene flow estimation.

 Bonus Qualifications

 Experience optimizing models for TensorRT/CUDA to achieve low-latency inference.

 Familiarity with sparse convolutions or query-based architectures for efficient 3D processing.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, ML Training Optimization
descriptionPlain:
Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and build ground-up autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. We’re still early in deploying on public roads, so this is a great time to join and have a significant impact.    The Opportunity
   Are you excited to own ML training optimization at Zoox and make the models that power autonomous driving train faster, cheaper, and at greater scale? You’ll set technical direction for distributed training, parallelism strategies, mixed-precision training, and RL on SOTA accelerators, especially for multi-modal VLA and VLM models. title: Staff Technical Program Manager - Compute Hardware
descriptionPlain:
Zoox is building a fleet of purpose-built robotaxis from the ground up — and the Advanced Hardware Engineering (AHE) team delivers the physical intelligence that makes autonomy real: the sensors, compute, and electronics that let our vehicles perceive, reason, and drive. title: Senior Software Engineer - Mapping Web
descriptionPlain:
The Mapping Web team builds the geospatial visualization tools that enable Zoox engineers to understand and reason about the robot’s world. The team develops internal map visualization libraries that power rendering across a wide range of applications.

 We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to own and advance these core libraries. This person will extend rendering capabilities, strengthen the underlying architecture, and create scalable foundations that other engineering teams can build upon. Deep, hands-on experience with map and geospatial visualization is required for this role.

 In this role, you will:

 Own and extend our deck.gl-based map visualization library.

 Design and deliver new 2D and 3D rendering capabilities for geospatial data, road networks, lane geometry, and our proprietary road network structures.

 Partner with teams such as Cartography and Simulation to translate their visualization needs into scalable features.

 Improve rendering performance for large, complex map datasets.

 Elevate code quality, documentation, and test coverage while mentoring engineers on geospatial rendering and React/deck.gl patterns.

 Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong expertise in React, modern TypeScript and Python.

 Hands-on experience with deck.gl, Mapbox GL, MapLibre, or a comparable WebGL-based mapping or 3D visualization library.

 Strong knowledge of geospatial data concepts, including coordinate systems, tiling, and vector and raster rendering.

 Experience designing and maintaining libraries or platforms used by other engineering teams, with a strong focus on correctness, modularity, testability, and code quality.

 Bonus Qualifications

 Experience working with large-scale geospatial datasets in autonomous vehicle, mapping, or GIS environments.

 Familiarity with WebGL and GPU rendering performance optimization.

 Demonstrated success providing technical mentorship and collaborating across teams on shared infrastructure.

title: System Test Engineer

You will be leading the integration and validation of autonomy, robotics, and autonomous behaviors to ensure the product meets safety, customer needs, and milestone readiness.  In this role, you will:

 Focus on automating testing utilizing internal Hardware in the Loop (HIL) and Software in the Loop (SIL) assets

 Analyze vehicle logs and test data using in-house tools to trace failures for root cause analysis, documentation, and communication

 Support the defect management process from recognition to resolution

 Qualifications:

 3+ years of industry experience in testing complex systems (autonomy, robotics, and autonomous behaviors)

 Experience with designing, developing, and executing test methodologies that scale across multiple teams

 Strong software development experience with high-level language (e.g. Python, Pytest, REST API), along with version control systems (e.g Git)
